embeds.description:
Data freshness: PropFinder team share + coverage 8:58am CT, PropFinder props (book, Pinnacle and Novig prices) 9:07am CT, PF injury report 9:08am CT - all live pulls this run. Pinnacle leans checked 9:05am CT (BI Pinnacle Reports, NFL, Today): 11 of 11 Sunday games posted (MNF DAL@PHI not on the page yet). X NFL Beats list read 9:13am CT.
Injuries: Lamar Jackson OUT (Huntley starts), Montgomery OUT (Marks + Ogunbowale only RBs), Tank Dell activated (HOU), Egbuka OUT, Evans/Deebo/Aiyuk OUT (SF), Jeremiyah Love OUT, Warren and Gould OUT (IND), Rice OUT. Q: Puka (calf, updated this morning), Breece Hall, Mayfield (thumb), Ridley, Spears, M. Washington (Raiders did not elevate a RB), Jonah Coleman, Zaccheaus.
Weather: only CAR notable (11 mph, gusts 20, 66F) - mild. BAL/NYJ/TEN/SEA calm.
Sample: 35-23, +7.08u (58 graded) - noise until 50+ per tier. TNF Week 7 picks grade Tuesday.
Run reading: Sun 9am morning card. No 8:30 PULL output found in the project (latest.json was Oct 22), so this run pulled everything itself. PIT@NO (London) already kicked off - skipped. MNF DAL@PHI not in scope this morning. Not swept: CSI/Discord, KoalatyStats, Novig site ladders (Novig from PropFinder prices), alt lines, BI game pages (Pinnacle lines from the Reports page). DFS: no Week 7 salary file found.
